answer: Incident: 400 keys attested in one hour, all from a single vine of vouchers. Cause: weight never decayed and no rule stopped a recruiter from grading its own recruit. Fix: decay idle standing 25 percent per epoch, cut weight for every claim that fails verification, block self-audit entirely. After that an attack needs a real beacon of activity per key every epoch, and the orchard of dormant accounts pays nothing while it waits.
